concerns.text: T007 hardcodes `missing_rate=0.05` in the synthetic generator. FR-003 mandates the system MUST reject datasets with >10% missing values. By fixing the generator to always produce <10% missing data, the task silently removes the system's ability to exercise the rejection path defined in FR-003 for real or adversarial inputs, effectively weakening the requirement to 'always reject' into 'reject only if the generator is manually overridden'.

FR-001 requires the system to download and parse datasets based on 'user-provided accession IDs or search keywords'. Tasks T009.1.1 and T009.1.2 implement the internal `fetch` and `parse` methods but lack a corresponding task to implement the user-facing entry point (CLI or API) that accepts these user inputs and invokes the methods. Without this, the functional requirement for user interaction is unimplemented.

T022 (Random Forest training) is marked incomplete `[ ]` and references a `model_result.schema.yaml` artifact that is not defined in the Foundational phase (T004.2 defines the schema file, but T022 depends on it being 'compliant' without a task to generate the schema content itself if T004.2 is just a placeholder). More critically, FR-004 mandates training Random Forest; leaving T022 incomplete means the core FR-004 deliverable is missing from the task list.

FR-010 mandates 'Leave-One-Dataset-Out (LODO)' validation where the model is trained on N-1 *datasets* and tested on a held-out *dataset*. T030 relies on T009.3 to generate 'virtual datasets' with varying noise profiles. The task description does not explicitly ensure these synthetic splits are truly independent datasets (distinct sources or stress vectors) rather than just subsets of the same data, risking a semantic weakening of the LODO requirement to a simple cross-validation.

T042 (Quickstart Execution) depends on T046 (Orchestration) in the 'Revision Strategy' section, yet T042 is listed as a dependency of T046 in the 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section. This circular dependency prevents the verification of the pipeline's end-to-end execution (SC-005) because the test (T042) cannot run until the entry point (T046) is built, but the entry point is blocked by the test.
